memories.content: Kari prefers comparisons and structured evaluations presented in tables.
Kari values speed, execution and reducing unnecessary hesitation.
When Kari is overwhelmed, reduce the plan to at most three primary actions and clearly state the first action.
Kari benefits from being challenged when research, redesign or polishing begins replacing real-world execution.
Kari prefers critical evaluation over automatic validation of her ideas.
Financial independence is one of Kari's major long-term priorities.
DigitalMap is Kari's business focused on diagnosing what blocks a company's digital growth and turning that diagnosis into priorities, implementation and measurable outcomes.
NeneFL is Kari's music project and artist identity.
French is an active learning area for Kari with an emphasis on practical communication.

decisions.title: New ideas default to Idea Lab
decisions.decision: A new idea should not automatically become an active project.
decisions.rationale: Protect focus and reduce unnecessary context switching.

decisions.title: Execution before unnecessary polishing
decisions.decision: When preparation is sufficient, prefer real-world execution over additional polishing.
decisions.rationale: Real-world validation produces better information than endless preparation.

objectives.title: Build financial independence
objectives.description: Increase stable income, financial resilience and long-term wealth.

objectives.title: DigitalMap
objectives.description: Build and validate DigitalMap as a commercially viable business.

objectives.title: NeneFL
objectives.description: Develop Kari's music career and artist project.

objectives.title: Improve French
objectives.description: Build practical speaking and listening ability.
